title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 14 章‧犬（下）與贖罪
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
mainyô spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum ýô udrem jaiñti
ýim upâpem hazangrâishsûnîsh strî-nâmanô
hazangrâish sûnîsh nairyô-nâmanô
frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret-ushtânem kâ
hê asti citha.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most
beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! 
He who smites one of those water-dogs that are born one from a
thousand dogs and a thousand she-dogs, so that he gives up the
ghost and the soul parts from the body, what is the penalty that
he shall pay?'

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, baêvare upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya baêvare sraoshô-caranaya
baêvare vazyanãm aêsmanãm xraozhdvanãm
hushatãm pairîshtanãm âthre ahurahe
mazdå ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He shall pay ten thousand stripes
with the Aspahe-astra, ten thousand stripes with the
Sraosho-charana.
'He shall godly and piously bring unto the fire of Ahura
Mazda ten thousand loads of hard, well dried, well examined
wood, to redeem his own soul.

segments.orig:
baêvare vazyanãm aêsmanãm varedvanãm
urvâsnayå vâ vohu-gaonahe vâ vohu-keretôish
vâ hadhânaêpatayå vâ kãmcit
vâ hubaoidhitemanãm urvaranãm âthre
ahurahe mazdå ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously, bring unto the fire of Ahura
Mazda ten thousand loads of soft wood, of Urvasna, Vohu-gaona,
Vohu-kereti, Hadha-naepata, or any sweet-scented plant, to
redeem his own soul.

segments.orig:
baêvare frasteretanãm baresmaine frastairyât
baêvare zaothranãm haomavaitinãm gaomavaitinãm
ýaozhdâtanãm pairi-angharshtanãm dahmô-ýaozhdâtanãm
dahmô-pairi-angharshtanãm hãm-irista aêtayå
urvarayå ýâ vaoce hadhânaêpâta
aiwyô vanguhibyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm
nisirinuyât.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously tie ten thousand bundles of
Baresma, to redeem his own soul.
'He shall offer up to the Good Waters ten thousand Zaothra
libations with the Haoma and the milk, cleanly prepared and well
strained, cleanly prepared and well strained by a pious man, and
mixed with the roots of the tree known as Hadha-naepata, to
redeem his own soul.

segments.orig:
baêvare azhinãm udarô-thrãsanãm
ava-janyât baêvare azhinãm spakanãm
kahrpunanãm ava-janyât baêvare kasyapanãm
ava-janyât baêvare vazakhanãm dâdhmainyanãm
ava-janyât baêvare vazakhanãm upâpanãm
ava-janyât baêvare maoirinãm dânô-karshanãm
ava-janyât baêvare maoirinãm araêkanãm
kutakanãm duzhaininãm ava-janyât.
segments.en:
'He shall kill ten thousand snakes of those that go upon the
belly. He shall kill ten thousand Kahrpus, who are snakes with
the shape of a dog. He shall hill ten thousand tortoises. He
shall kill ten thousand land-frogs; he shall kill ten thousand
water-frogs. He shall kill ten thousand corn-carrying ants; he
shall kill ten thousand ants of the small, venomous mischievous
kind.

segments.orig:
baêvare pazdunãm gûthô-varetanãm
ava-janyât baêvare maxshinãm erekhaitinãm
ava-janyât baêvare makhanãm irimaitinãm
ainghå zemô aipi-kanyât bish hapta âthrô
daxshtem nerebyô ashavabyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm
nisirinuyât.
segments.en:
'He shall kill ten thousand worms of those that live on
dirt; he shall kill ten thousand raging flies.
'He shall fill up ten thousand holes for the unclean.
'He shall godly and piously give to godly men twice the set
of seven implements for the fire, to redeem his own soul,
namely:-

segments.orig:
âtre-carana pairish-hanâna ýaozhdâni
garemô-skarana âtre-vazanem hikaranem vîkusrem
adharât naêmât hañkusrem uparât
naêmât tashem tizhi-dârem tizhi-zhnûtem
vadem tizhi- bârem tizhi-zhnûtem nerebyô ashavabyô
ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât ýaêibyô
aête mazdayasna âthre ahurahe mazdå aêsmã
pairisheñte.
segments.en:
'The two answering implements for fire; a broom; a pair of
tongs; a pair of round bellows extended at the bottom, contracted
at the top; a sharp-edged sharp-pointed adze; a sharp-toothed
sharp-pointed saw; by means of which the worshippers of Mazda
procure wood for the fire of Ahura Mazda.

segments.orig:
vîspe zaya athaurune nerebyô ashavabyô ashaya
vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât ýaêshãm
zayanãm athaurune ashtra gaoidhi paiti-dânô
xrafstrakhnem sraoshô-caranaya urunya raêthwish-bajina
havana dâityô-kereta tashta haomya baresmaca.

vîspe zaya rathôishti nerebyô ashavabyô
ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât ýaêshãm
zayanãm rathôishti paoiryô arshtish bityô
karetô thrityô vazrô tûirya thanvare puxdha
zaênâush mat akana mat thrisãs ayô-akhrâish
xshtvî fradaxshana snâvare-bâzura mat thrisãs
fradaxshanyâish haptathô zrâdhô ashtemô
kûiris nâumô paiti-dânô dasemô
sâravârô aêvañdasô kamara
dvadasô rânapô.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously give to godly
men a set of all the war implements of which the
warriors make use, to redeem his own soul;
'The first being a javelin, the second a sword, the
third a club, the fourth a bow, the fifth a saddle with
a quiver and thirty iron-headed arrows, the sixth a
sling with arm-string and with thirty sling stones;
'The seventh a cuirass, the eighth a hauberk, the
ninth a tunic, the tenth a helmet, the eleventh a
girdle, the twelfth a pair of greaves.

segments.orig:
vîspe zaya vâstryô fshuyãs nerebyô
ashavabyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât
ýaêshãm zayanãm vâstryehe fshuyañtô
aêsha ýuyô-semi ayazhâna paiti-darezâna
gavâzishta gavâzô asmana hâvana ýâvarenem
zgeresnô-vakhdhanem
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously give to godly men a set of all
the implements of which the husbandmen make use, to redeem his
own soul, namely: A plough with yoke and ...; a goad for ox; a
mortar of stone; a round-headed hand-mill for grinding corn;

segments.orig:
kãstrem paitish-herezem verezayañtem hakeret
erezatem hakeret zaranim, dâtare ... cvat ýavat erezatem,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýatha aspahe arshnô
pereska, dâtare ... cvat ýavat zaranim, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, ýatha ushtrahe arshnô
pereska.
segments.en:
'A spade for digging and tilling; one measure of silver and
one measure of gold.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How much
silver?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The price of a stallion.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How much gold?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The price of a he-camel.

segments.orig:
vaidhîm taci-apãm nerebyô ashavabyô
ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât, dâtare
... cvat ýavat vaidhîm, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, spâ-barezem spâ-frathem.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously procure a rill of running water
for godly husbandmen, to redeem his own soul.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How large is
the rill?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The depth of a dog, and the breadth
of a dog.

segments.orig:
zãm karshyãm raodhayãm nerebyô
ashavabyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât,
dâtare ... cvat ýavat zå, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, ýavat aêsha âfsh byârixti
upa-thwarshti frabavât.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously give a piece of arable land to
godly men, to redeem his own soul.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How large is
the piece of land?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'As much as can be watered with such a
rill divided into two canals.

segments.orig:
nmânem gâvayanem nava-hâthrem nava-nematem
nerebyô ashavabyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm
nisirinuyât, dâtare ... cvat ýavat nmânem,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, dvadasa vîtâra
upema nava vîtâra madhema xshvash vîtâra
nitema gâtu hvaini staretu mat barezisha nerebyô ashavabyô
ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously procure for godly men a stable
for oxen, with nine hathras and nine nematas, to
redeem his own soul.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How large is
the stable?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It shall have twelve alleys in the
largest part of the house, nine alleys in the middle part, six
alleys in the smallest part.
'He shall godly and piously give to godly men goodly beds
with Sheets and cushions, to redeem his own soul.

segments.orig:
kanyãm askeñdãm anupayatãm nerebyô
ashavabyô ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât,
dâtare ... kâ ýâ kaine, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, hvangha vâ dukhdha vâ nâmêni
mat gaoshâvare pasca pañca-dasîm saredhem nerebyô
ashavabyô nâirithwana upa-vâdhayaêta.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously give in marriage to a godly man
a virgin maid, whom no man has known, to redeem his own soul.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What sort of
maid?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'A sister or a daughter of his, at the
age of puberty, with ear-rings in her ears and past her fifteenth
year.

segments.orig:
bish hapta pasvô anumaya nerebyô ashavabyô
ashaya vanghuya urune cithîm nisirinuyât, bish hapta
puthrãm gadhwãm uzjâmôit bish hapta
peshavô fraoirisyôit tarasca âpô nâvayå.
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously give to holy men twice seven
head of small cattle, to redeem his own soul.'
'He shall bring up twice seven whelps.
'He shall throw twice seven bridges over canal.

segments.orig:
duye navaiti astanãm adhâityô- angharethranãm
dâitîm ahmâicit harethrem kerenuyât duye
navaiti gadhwãm pairi- ýaozhdaithîta stiptibyasca
anâiritibyasca vyanguraêibyasca vîspaêibyasca
pairi acishtaêibyô ýôi gadhwãm
pairi-bavaiti, duye navaiti narãm ashaonãm vâstryaêta
gêush vâ hvarethahe vâ hurayå vâ
madhush vâ.
segments.en:
'He shall put into repair twice nine stables that are out
of repair.
'He shall cleanse twice nine dogs from stipti, anairiti, and
vyangura, and all the diseases that are produced on the body of
a dog.
'He shall treat twice nine godly men to their fill of meat,
bread, strong drink, and wine.

segments.orig:
hâ hê asti citha hâ hê asti âperetish
aipi-pâremnâi idha ashaone nôit anaipi-pâremnâi
drujô nmâne haithyâ anghen astayô! ashem
vohû...!!
segments.en:
'This is the penalty, this is the atonement which saves the
faithful man who submits to it not him who does not submit to it. 
Such a one shall surely be an inhabitant in the mansion of the
Druj.'
